name: Small Business Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
benefit: 1. The maximum loan limit is ₹2,00,000/- per individual. 1. The interest rate is 6% per annum. 1. The loan amount disbursed is 95% of the total project cost. 1. The beneficiary Contribution is 5% of the total project cost.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
